modules.name: 10185 - main model.ldr
modules.description: Green Grocer (LEGO Modular Building, set 10185): a four-level corner building with a detailed ground-floor grocery shop (vegetable baskets, goods shelves, post boxes, cashier desk and till, shopping window, gateway entrance and awning), a first-floor apartment (fireplace with flame, banister staircase, bay/jutty windows, cat, fire escape), a second-floor apartment (grandfather clock, heater, jutty roof and fire escape) and a furnished rooftop (chimney, barbecue grill, umbrella table, turntable and flower boxes), accompanied by four minifigures and a baby buggy
